paras: The eyebrowed heleia (Heleia superciliaris), also known as the cream-browed white-eye, cream-browed ibon or yellow-browed white-eye, is a species of bird in the white-eye family Zosteropidae.  It is endemic to the Lesser Sunda Islands. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical moist montane forest.
